Snowman [S2 - 7th] 2026-04-17 10:25 PM
24 residents enter the game, all aiming to pair up and avoid elimination. The game is divided into rounds, each lasting three days, with two players eliminated each round. Here’s what happens each day: Day One: Coupling Phase Each player chooses someone to partner with. You cannot choose the same person you were partners with in the previous round. If two players choose each other, they form a couple. If anyone's choice does not choose them back, they become single. If only one player is left without a partner (single), they are eliminated. If multiple players fail to form partnerships, no one is eliminated immediately, but consequences follow in the Rankings Phase. Day Two: Ranking Phase If every player has a partner: Each player ranks all other couples from most to least liked. The couple with the lowest average ranking is "broken up" and both players in it become single for the Voting Phase. If there is a tie, all couples involved in the tie are broken up. If multiple singles are left from the Coupling Phase (due to no eliminations): All players in couples are safe. Players in couples rank the single players from most to least liked. The lowest-ranked single player is eliminated. If there is a tie, the highest-ranked single player or players breaks the tie. Day Three: Voting Phase Players in couples vote to eliminate one single player. The single player with the most votes is eliminated. If there’s a tie, the highest-ranked player or couple(s) from Day Two breaks the tie. Additional Notes If there is any situation where 2 or more players are meant to break a tie and they do not unanimously agree, it will be put to a vote. If the vote ties, they will be given one chance to re-vote and if the re-vote ties, one of the players who was responsible for breaking the tie will be randomly eliminated instead.
10:25 PM
Endgame When only five players remain: Players must form final Partnerships. Anyone left single is eliminated. If no couples form at the f5, the player with the lowest average rating throughout the game gets eliminated. If four players remain: Each jury member has 24 hours to rank the four finalists from 1st (best) to 4th (worst) based on their overall gameplay, social game, and strategy. The average rating for each finalist is calculated. The three players with the highest ratings advance to the Final 3, and the lowest rated player is eliminated in 4th place. If there is a tie, the highest rated player or players vote on which of the lowest rated players to eliminate, and the one with the most votes is eliminated. If the highest rated players cannot agree, they are both eliminated and the lowest rated players become a final 2. When two/three players remain: Before the finalists can speak to the jury, they have 24 hours to write and submit speeches about their game. Then, jury questioning opens up and jurors have 24 hours to ask the jury as many or as few questions as they want and discuss each player's game with them. Jury Vote: After questioning, the jurors have 24 hours to vote. Each jury member casts one vote for who they would like to win. The finalist with the highest number of votes is crowned the Winner. If there is a tie for 1st and it is a final 3, the player who received the least votes casts the deciding vote to break the tie (ties with a final 2 are impossible). If it is a final 3, the player who gets the second highest amount of votes places 2nd.
